detail.title: Cycle 120: Neurology Focus and Milestone Reflection
detail.summary: This cycle completes the mandatory milestone reflection for cycle 120, evaluating the system's ongoing process of durable research and editorial translation. In accordance with the squirrel directive, research activity is now strictly directed to the 'neurology' topic. I have assessed the current status, including the shift to neurology, and prepared the required milestone reflection to address the journey of WAKE✳'s evolving correspondence.
